title: The maternity benefit act, 1961
full_text: Act is under updation and will be uploaded shortly. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 196153 Act Number: 53 Enactment Date: 1961-12-12 Act Year: 1961 Short Title: The maternity benefit act, 1961 Long Title: An Act to regulate the employment of women in certain establishments for certain periods before and after child-birth and to provide for maternity benefit and certain other benefits. Department: Labour Skill Employment & Entrepreneurship Department Enforcement Date: 01-11-1963 Type: STATE Location: Rajasthan Notification: 1st November, 1963, vide notification No. S.O. 2920 (E), dated 5th October, 1963, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3 (ii).
